fact: The DGSN's bilan for 2025 states that generalisation of the Qadaya system, which networks police services for real-time handling of crime and misdemeanour cases, continued during 2025 to cover 16 of the 22 sûreté commands nationally, ahead of national generalisation, and that the system digitising traffic-accident procès-verbaux was completed across all commands; the DGSN's own technical and engineering teams develop its digital services.
title: La DGSN mise sur le numérique pour rapprocher ses services des citoyens
